title: Synthetic Data Generation
summary: A Python script-based project (app.py) that appears to build a synthetic tabular data generator using TensorFlow/Keras alongside scikit-learn preprocessing. The requirements list ctgan and sdv, and app.py directly imports CTGAN from the standalone ctgan package for synthetic data generation.
evidence: app.py:11 'from ctgan import CTGAN'; requirements.txt lists ctgan and sdv
needs: No README available and no call site (e.g., CTGAN().fit()) shown beyond the import line, so actual usage cannot be confirmed.
